description:
Why Lawachara National Park Sreemangal is a MUST VISIT in 2025 । Sultan Rony। Travel vlog

If you want to get a taste of a mysterious rainforest, Lawachara is the perfect place to visit. There are plenty of opportunities for trekking and jungle walks in the well-maintained forest offices. You can enjoy more than 460 species of birds, mammals and reptiles living in this forest. These include deer, wild chickens, squirrels, pythons, the endangered hulk gibbon, capped langur, slow loris bird, snakes, banana spiders, etc. You can enjoy hiking and walking to enjoy yourself in nature close to the wildlife using the numerous trails in the forest.

Lawachara National Park is a major national park and nature reserve in Bangladesh. The park is located in Kamalganj Upazila of Moulvibazar District in the northeastern part of the country. It is located within the 2,740 hectares (27.4 sq km) West Bhanugachh Reserve Forest.

Lawachhara National Park covers an area of ​​about 1,250 hectares (12.5 sq km) of semi-evergreen forest biome and mixed deciduous forest biome. The Bangladesh government declared this land a national park on 7 July 1996 under the Wildlife Act of 1974.
